notes.title: Solitar 1.4.1 - Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed button refresh issue with "Big Gin" in Gin Rummy
 Improved drop location when dropping a card via drag/drop

notes.title: 1.2.6 - Bug fixes, more UI improvements and Demo version in the works
notes.notes:
Bug fixes, more UI improvements


 Fixed broken undo option on lost game prompt (was triggering a new game)
 Fixed Spider "No more moves available" issue (now takes in consideration different suits)
 Fixed "Nuclei" & "Pipe Fever" tooltips for main menu buttons (don't display win count)
 Improved draw piles rendering to reflect the number of contained cards
 Improved card double click precision
 Improved button click sound to be more subtle
 Improved Spider rules
 Added velocity to moving cards

A demo version is also in the works.  This demo version will only include the game Klondike, and will not include any achievements or stats, changing themes will also be disabled.

notes.title: Solitar Update 1.2.5 - More UI Updates
notes.notes:
Added slide animation of popups and various UI elements
 Added background pulse animation to main menu game buttons
 Added achievement badges to main menu game buttons
 Added ability to select between smooth, textured and random table backgrounds
 Added various tooltips

notes.title: Launch Update
notes.notes:
Happy Monday,

Quick update, I’ve decided to postpone the release to July 12th, first this gives me more time to tackle feedback received during pre-release play testing.  And secondly it was recommended by Valve because of the upcoming Steam sale, as visibility will be prioritized to games that are participating in the sale event.  I’m currently waiting on Steam support to update the release date.

Cheers
